gloss: points to note; precautions; things to be aware of

definitions.gloss: points to note; precautions; items requiring attention
definitions.explanation: The set of things a reader or participant must keep in mind: warnings, conditions, and rules listed on a form, a manual, or an announcement. Nearly always plural in sense and presented as a list.

examples.japanese: {注意事項|ちゅういじこう}をお{読|よ}みください。
examples.english: Please read the points to note.

examples.japanese: {申込書|もうしこみしょ}の{裏面|りめん}に{注意事項|ちゅういじこう}が{書|か}いてある。
examples.english: The precautions are written on the back of the application form.

examples.japanese: {出発前|しゅっぱつまえ}に{注意事項|ちゅういじこう}を{確認|かくにん}しておかないと、{現地|げんち}で{困|こま}ることがある。
examples.english: If you don't check the guidance points before departure, you may run into trouble on site.

notes:
Formed from {注意|ちゅうい} (caution, attention) plus {事項|じこう} (items, matters). Standard on forms, tickets, manuals, and event announcements; the tone is administrative rather than urgent.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {注意事項|ちゅういじこう}を{確認|かくにん}する: to check the points to note
- {注意事項|ちゅういじこう}をよく{読|よ}む: to read the precautions carefully
- {注意事項|ちゅういじこう}を{守|まも}る: to observe the stated rules
- {以下|いか}の{注意事項|ちゅういじこう}: the following points

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {注意書|ちゅういが}き: a written warning — the printed text itself, often a single line
- {警告|けいこく}: warning — far stronger, used where there is real danger
